description: The framework operationalizes educational control — \"the ability to preserve a task's instructional intent while shifting its cognitive demand toward specified learning objectives\" — using revised Bloom's Taxonomy as an ordinal scale from Remember (1) to Create (6).
title: Bloom-aligned framework for measuring educational control in LLMs

description: A Bloom's-Taxonomy-driven framework for evaluating LLM-generated educational questions that pivots \"from a knowledge-point perspective to a cognitive-leap paradigm\".
title: Bloom-driven cognitive-leap evaluation framework with CogShift, category consistency, and knowledge coverage metrics

description: The article applies a new and innovative methodology for estimating sources of variation in program impacts (Bloom, 2012; Bloom, Raudenbush, & Weiss, 2013).
title: Bloom, Raudenbush, and Weiss multilevel methodology for estimating variation in program impacts across individuals, subgroups, and sites
